keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Burnley 1. Andréas Hountondji (Burnley) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lucas Pires with a through ball.
Delay in match (Cardiff City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Burnley 2. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jaydon Banel.
Goal! Cardiff City 1, Burnley 2. Ollie Tanner (Cardiff City) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rubin Colwill following a corner.
First Half ends, Cardiff City 1, Burnley 2.
Krystian Bielik (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Cardiff City 1, Burnley 3. Largie Ramazani (Burnley) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner following a fast break.
Substitution, Burnley. Aaron Ramsey replaces Marcus Edwards.
Substitution, Burnley. Josh Cullen replaces Reo Hatate.
Own Goal by Alex Robertson, Cardiff City. Cardiff City 1, Burnley 4.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Yousef Salech replaces Ollie Tanner.
Substitution, Burnley. Connor Roberts replaces Lucas Pires.
Substitution, Burnley. Oliver Sonne replaces Jaydon Banel.
Goal! Cardiff City 2, Burnley 4. Yousef Salech (Cardiff City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Cian Ashford.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Calum Scanlon replaces Krystian Bielik.
Goal! Cardiff City 3, Burnley 4. Jack Moylan (Cardiff City) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Joel Bagan (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card.
Largie Ramazani (Burnley) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Burnley. Zeki Amdouni replaces Andréas Hountondji.
Goal! Cardiff City 4, Burnley 4. Yousef Salech (Cardiff City) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Rubin Colwill with a cross.
Delay in match (Cardiff City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
